name: Phantom Phage (CR 3)
body:
Phantom Phage
CR 3

Notice Perception DC 15 (to hear a child’s voice, quivering with fear, ask “What’s on your face, mommy?”; hp 6
Trigger proximity; Reset automatic (24 hours)

EFFECT

The haunted character must make a DC 14 Will save; failure indicates he claws desperately at the flesh of his own face, dealing 1d6 points of damage and 1d4 points of Charisma damage.
